invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Native customer duration never reaches vendor Brief authority

evidence.note: VID1009 G1 passed; actual creative22s conflicts with original30s and G2 rejects. Actual host+vendor-prototype regression observes22 rather than30 before fix.

cards.trigger_path: Public prepare normalizes customer30s requirement in intent -> studio carries no brief.duration -> actual _applyBriefProfile cannot enforce customer contract -> creative generator22s -> G2 rejects before images/videos.

assertions.given: Standard customer requirement blocks, missing/invalid/conflicting clauses and actual vendor-derived22sec theme
assertions.expect: Explicit30sec and9:16 reach existing vendor Brief authority before G2; missing requirements add no duration; malformed/conflicting values reject and per-project snapshots remain isolated.

cards.fix_plan: Project the already standardized native requirement block into existing Brief scalar fields before vendor construction, preserve raw intent hash and exact clauses, reject conflicting values. No creative rewrite or weakened gate.
cards.blast_radius: Customer duration/aspect/platform handoff only; G1 facts, G2 semantic review, creative planning, model/provider and media retries remain unchanged.

regression.command: node --import tsx --test scripts/native-intent-profile.test.mts; vitest run packages/video-studio/src/studio.test.ts apps/server/src/video/studio-worker.test.ts packages/video-studio/src/pipeline-router.test.ts

cards.rollback: Revert only native requirement projection; preserve rejectedVID1009, all raw claims/review and archived attempts; do not resubmit media.
